dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Constant linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized indentation on the right lateral margin approximately mid-body where skin meets the water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate dark-grey across the primary visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse patches of lighter grey pixels concentrated on the central and right dorsal areas.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the darker base pigment and lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, high-contrast linear streaks consistent with rake marks on the lower-right quadrant; single high-intensity specular highlight near the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear scars/marks visible on the posterior right dorsal flank.
